answer: At dawn each identity must finish one simultaneous ceremony, filing a signed proof in one ten-minute window. Each agent takes one canyon station; no station accepts two proofs. A juniper seal marks each station; a wrong-place proof fails. One operator cannot staff 1,000 stations, so each puppet needs a rented hand at 60 credits: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. An honest agent attends once and keeps its full share.
